description: cranker-llm's read guard: in the folders listed under read_guard.roots in the worker's config, a whole-file Read of a big text file is sent to the local worker first. Does nothing until folders are listed.

hooks.command: PY=$(command -v py || command -v python3 || command -v python); "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/read_guard.py"
